array.string: MARKER="/tmp/openclaw-update-requested"; LOG="/Users//.openclaw/logs/update-check-launchd.log"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"; if [ -f "$MARKER" ]; then echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Marker found, running update-openclaw.sh --apply" >> "$LOG"; /bin/bash /Users//openclaw-agents/scripts/update-openclaw.sh --apply >> "$LOG" 2>&1; rm -f "$MARKER"; echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Update complete, marker removed" >> "$LOG"; else echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] No marker, skipping" >> "$LOG"; fi
